Spawning

[edit | edit source]

Hideyho spawns somewhere inside the Haunted biome.

Behavior

[edit | edit source]

Hideyho spawns somewhere in the Haunted biome. If the player interacts with it, they can start a game of hide and seek, causing it to hide somewhere else in the Haunted biome and apply Blindness II for 1 second. Upon being found again, it rewards the player with a  Hideyho Shard.

The amount of  Hideyho Shards dropped is affected by  Hunting Fortune. Hideyho also grants +5,000  Hunting XP once per instance.

The amount of  Hideyho Shards depends on how long it took the player to find it. If the player takes longer than 1m to find Hideyho, they get  1 Hideyho Shard. If the player takes 1m or less, they get  2 Hideyho Shards. If the player finds them in 30s or less, they get  3 Hideyho Shards.

Tips

[edit | edit source]
  • Once Hideyho teleports to a different location, particles on the ground will hint on the direction it teleported to.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Hideyho is the only mob in the Critterdex that cannot get captured with a  Critter Capsule.
